# Changelog

## 1.0.0 — 2026-10-06

Initial public DH-ADOM package.

Includes:

- White paper v1.0 with publication positioning and research framing.
- Normative technical specification.
- JSON Schemas for agents, features, delegations, and audit events.
- Root / Feature / Specialist templates.
- Reference implementation with root routing, feature ownership, specialist delegation, budgets, audit, and handoffs.
- Implementation-neutral conformance suite.
- Benchmark task definitions and experiment tooling.
- Architecture diagrams in Mermaid, Graphviz source, SVG, and PNG.
- Website-ready publication package.
- Citation and versioning artifacts.
